templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py

templates.subtitle: Standardized PCA via SVD · score-unit-scaled loading arrows

templates.name: 实测–预测一致性图
templates.purpose: 比较预测值与真实值，配合1:1参考线

templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Prediction meets observation
templates.subtitle: One-to-one reference · equal axis scales
templates.method: Synthetic out-of-sample-style predictions. R² is 1−SSE/SST, not squared Pearson correlation. These are demonstration values, not a trained research model.

templates.name: 残差诊断图
templates.purpose: 检查预测误差随拟合值或变量的模式
templates.inputs: 残差；拟合值或解释变量
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: What the residuals reveal
templates.subtitle: OLS diagnostics · common residual definition
templates.method: OLS residuals = observed−fitted. Standardization uses residual RMS with n−2 df; Q–Q line is fitted by scipy.stats.probplot. Synthetic heteroscedasticity is intentional.

templates.name: 泰勒图
templates.purpose: 综合比较相关性、标准差和中心化误差
templates.inputs: 参考及预测序列；或对应统计量
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Agreement in one plane
templates.subtitle: Standard deviation · correlation · centered RMS difference
templates.method: Taylor radius uses sample SD, angle=arccos(Pearson r). Contours are centered RMS differences with sample normalization (n−1). Only nonnegative correlations are supported in this quarter-plane example.

templates.name: ROC曲线
templates.purpose: 比较分类模型在不同阈值下的表现
templates.inputs: 真实标签；预测分数；类别定义
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Sensitivity versus specificity
templates.subtitle: Binary synthetic holdout · threshold sweep
templates.method: Labels sampled from known logistic probabilities; noisy generating scores are evaluated on 600 synthetic examples. ROC/AUC computed with scikit-learn, no invented performance values.

templates.name: 精确率–召回率曲线 PR
templates.purpose: 观察分类查准率与查全率的权衡
templates.inputs: 真实标签；预测分数
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Precision under recall
templates.subtitle: Binary synthetic holdout · prevalence baseline
templates.method: AP is scikit-learn average precision (step-weighted), not trapezoidal PR AUC. Baseline equals class prevalence.

templates.name: 混淆矩阵图
templates.purpose: 展示各类别的正确与错误分类
templates.inputs: 真实/预测标签；或计数矩阵
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Where classification fails
templates.subtitle: Three-class confusion · row-normalized color + raw counts
templates.method: Deterministic synthetic example; arbitrary units unless stated.

templates.name: 概率校准曲线
templates.purpose: 比较预测概率与实际事件频率
templates.inputs: 真实标签；预测概率；分箱规则
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Can we trust the probability?
templates.subtitle: Reliability curve · quantile bins · sample counts
templates.method: Quantile-bin reliability points computed from observed binary outcomes; histogram uses equal-width bins and is separately labeled. No confidence intervals are implied.

templates.name: 学习曲线
templates.purpose: 比较训练/验证性能随样本量等的变化
templates.inputs: 样本量或训练轮次；指标；训练/验证分组
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Learning with more data
templates.subtitle: Logistic regression · five stratified folds · mean ± SD
templates.method: A logistic regression is actually refitted for each size/fold using scikit-learn learning_curve. Band = sample SD across five folds, not a confidence interval; synthetic data only.

templates.name: Bode幅频–相频图
templates.purpose: 观察系统的频率响应
templates.inputs: 频率；幅值；相位；单位说明
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Frequency response
templates.subtitle: Second-order low-pass · magnitude and phase
templates.method: Transfer function H(s)=ω0²/(s²+2ζω0s+ω0²), f0=30 Hz, ζ=0.35. scipy.signal.bode receives angular frequency 2πf.

templates.name: Nyquist复阻抗图
templates.purpose: 展示阻抗实部与虚部的关系
templates.inputs: 频率；复阻抗或实部/虚部；符号约定
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Impedance in the complex plane
templates.subtitle: Rs + (R || C) · equal geometric scales
templates.method: Analytic impedance Z=Rs+R/(1+jωRC), Rs=8Ω, C=20µF. The plot uses −Im(Z) vertically; it is not the control-theory Nyquist stability contour.

templates.name: 极坐标角分布图
templates.purpose: 展示辐射方向性、角分辨信号等
templates.inputs: 角度；半径/强度；角度单位
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Angular signatures
templates.subtitle: Normalized intensity · radial scale shared across curves
templates.method: Deterministic synthetic example; arbitrary units unless stated.

templates.name: 功率谱密度图
templates.purpose: 展示功率随频率的分布
templates.inputs: 频率与PSD；或明确采样率及估计方法的信号
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Frequencies in the noise
templates.subtitle: Welch PSD · Hann window · density normalization
templates.method: Welch one-sided PSD, 1024-point Hann segments, 50% overlap, 512 Hz sampling. Density units V²/Hz; integration approximates signal variance.

templates.name: 短时傅里叶时频谱
templates.purpose: 展示非平稳信号频率随时间的变化
templates.inputs: 时频矩阵；或信号、采样率、窗函数
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: A signal changing frequency
templates.subtitle: Hann-window STFT · amplitude in dB relative to 1 V
templates.method: SciPy STFT with spectrum scaling; amplitude is |Z|, displayed as 20 log10(|Z|/1V), not a calibrated PSD. 192-sample Hann window, hop 24, FFT length 512.

templates.name: 小波时频图
templates.purpose: 展示不同尺度下的局部信号特征
templates.inputs: 小波结果；或信号、采样率、小波设置
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Local scale, local time
templates.subtitle: Complex Morlet CWT · edge-affected coefficients masked
templates.method: Independent discrete complex-Morlet convolution, ω0=6 with zero-mean correction; L2 scale normalization 1/√scale. Pseudo-frequency=ω0 fs/(2π scale). Power is coefficient magnitude² (arbitrary units, not PSD); √2-scale edge cone is masked.

templates.name: 自相关／互相关滞后图
templates.purpose: 观察周期、记忆性或两个信号的时延
templates.inputs: 信号序列或已计算的相关函数；滞后单位
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Timing the relationship
templates.subtitle: Autocorrelation + cross-correlation · normalized global energy
templates.method: Signals demeaned before correlation; normalization uses full-signal energy, not overlap-dependent unbiased normalization. Positive lag means y is delayed relative to x; injected delay=12 samples.

templates.name: 相空间轨迹图
templates.purpose: 展示动力学状态及其演化
templates.inputs: 状态变量序列；时间或轨迹分组
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: A dynamical signature
templates.subtitle: Lorenz trajectory · numerical integration · time-colored path
templates.method: Numerical Lorenz system, σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3, initial (1,1,1); solve_ivp tolerances 1e−8/1e−10. First 5 time units omitted as transient; not a physical experimental dataset.

templates.name: 主图＋局部放大图
templates.purpose: 保留整体趋势并突出峰或细节
templates.inputs: 主图数据；明确的放大区间
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: The detail within the whole
templates.subtitle: A local feature · linked zoomed inset
templates.method: Deterministic synthetic example; arbitrary units unless stated.

templates.name: 拟合＋残差双面板
templates.purpose: 同时检查拟合趋势与误差结构
templates.inputs: 原始数据；拟合结果；残差
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: A fit, and what it misses
templates.subtitle: Exponential relaxation · residuals share the x axis
templates.method: Deterministic synthetic example; arbitrary units unless stated.

templates.name: 散点＋边缘分布组合
templates.purpose: 结合变量关系及各自分布
templates.inputs: X/Y样本；分组可选
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: The cloud and its margins
templates.subtitle: Scatter with aligned marginal distributions
templates.method: Deterministic synthetic example; arbitrary units unless stated.

templates.name: 柱状／汇总值＋原始散点
templates.purpose: 同时呈现组间摘要和样本差异
templates.inputs: 原始样本；分组；明确的汇总口径
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Summary with the evidence
templates.subtitle: Means ± sample SD · all 25 observations per group
templates.method: Bar height=mean; whiskers=sample SD (ddof=1), not SEM. Every raw observation is shown; no p-values or significance stars.

templates.name: 分面小图矩阵
templates.purpose: 使用相同坐标或色条比较多组实验
templates.inputs: 分组；各面板数据；共享范围说明
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: One pattern, many conditions
templates.subtitle: Three materials × three settings · shared axis scales
templates.method: Deterministic synthetic example; arbitrary units unless stated.

templates.name: SHAP蜂群＋重要性条形组合
templates.purpose: 展示模型特征贡献及其总体排序
templates.inputs: 已计算SHAP值；特征值；特征名
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Explaining a linear model
templates.subtitle: Exact additive Shapley values · empirical marginal baseline
templates.method: For f(x)=intercept+β·x, interventional Shapley values with empirical marginal baseline are exactly φj=βj(xj−mean(Xj)). Saved coefficients define the actual demonstration model. Contributions sum exactly to f(x)−E[f(X)]; these are not arbitrary SHAP-like random dots.

templates.name: 火山图
templates.purpose: 同时展示效应大小与统计证据
templates.inputs: 效应量；P值或校正后P值；筛选阈值
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Magnitude meets evidence
templates.subtitle: Welch t-tests · Benjamini–Hochberg FDR · synthetic genes
templates.method: 900 synthetic genes, 8 independent log2-expression observations per group. Welch two-sided t-test per gene; BH-adjusted q-values. Thresholds q<0.05 and |difference in mean log2 expression|≥0.7; no real biological conclusions.

templates.name: Kaplan–Meier曲线＋风险表
templates.purpose: 比较时间到事件结果，保留删失信息
templates.inputs: 观察时长；事件/删失标记；分组
templates.implementation: Original Python template; shared presentation helpers in vlplot.py
templates.title: Time to an event
templates.subtitle: Right-censored Kaplan–Meier · censor marks + risk table
templates.method: Product-limit KM computed from observed durations/event flags; + marks right-censoring; risk table counts duration≥time (immediately before time). No confidence bands or treatment efficacy claims; n=90 synthetic subjects/cohort.
